subject: Participation Requested: Northfield University - Employment Systems Review
body:
Northfield University is conducting its first Employment Systems Review to better understand how employment policies, practices and workplace experiences shape employment equity. All full-time, permanent faculty and staff are invited to complete the employee survey. You do not need to identify as a member of an equity-deserving group to participate.

The survey takes approximately 15 minutes to complete. Participation is voluntary, and feedback will be used in aggregate to help identify strengths, barriers and opportunities for improvement. The survey is open until November 20.

Complete the Employment Systems Review survey or visit the Employment Systems Review website to learn more.

Employees who self-identify as women, racialized persons, Indigenous Peoples, persons with disabilities or members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community can indicate their interest in a facilitated focus group or one-on-one conversation at the end of the survey. These opportunities are also voluntary and provide a way to share more in-depth perspectives and experiences.

Thank you for helping us reach employees across the faculty. Broad participation will help ensure the review reflects a range of experiences and supports practical, evidence-informed recommendations to advance employment equity.

subject: Inside the 2026 AI Summit + intern and graduate program opportunities
body:
Getting Hired in AI: Breaking through in a complex market
Our talent panel, moderated by our Director of AI Talent Initiatives, brought together hiring leaders from a national bank, a telecom company, a consulting firm and a waste-management group. The panelists offered candid guidance for emerging professionals navigating an evolving job market:

Use AI to enhance your story, not invent it: AI tools can help refine resumes, but authentic project narratives and genuine communication are what impress interviewers;

Own the outcome: Hiring teams look beyond technical buzzwords. Candidates should clearly articulate the specific problem they solved, their individual contribution, and the measurable business impact; and

Demonstrate curiosity and breadth: End-to-end project ownership, active GitHub repositories, and strong human collaboration skills carry significant weight alongside technical depth.

The afternoon transitioned into an active Career Fair where attendees engaged directly with talent acquisition teams from leading organizations.
